info.title: User Service API
info.description: Accounts, profiles and seven-day sessions. Use the proxy UI for cookie-based requests: the session cookie is scoped to /api/user. Reset endpoint is opt-in and destructive.

servers.description: Same-origin Nginx or Angular development proxy

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Email/password access and private account details.

post.description: Creates account, profile, and session atomically. Password is stored as an Argon2id hash. Sets the HttpOnly g15_session cookie. Previous browser session is revoked. Confirmation must match.

parameters.name: X-G15-Request
parameters.description: Required on auth POSTs. JSON only; no CORS access.

400.description: Invalid account fields or mismatched confirmation.

409.description: Email or username is already taken.

403.description: Missing request header, non-JSON content, or cross-site request.

413.description: Request exceeds 16 KiB. Flask returns an HTML error.

post.description: Case-insensitive email lookup. Sets a fresh seven-day session cookie and revokes the previous browser session. Wrong email/password share a generic error.

post.description: Disabled unless AUTH_RESET_ENABLED=true and AUTH_RESET_TOKEN is set. Schema stays. all/users also remove dependent profiles, sessions, and watched history. user_sessions signs everyone out. Clearing user_profiles leaves accounts but current login needs their profiles. Transactional reset; never call just to view docs.

200.description: Cleared tables and deleted row counts.

400.description: JSON body must contain exactly one valid table field.

401.description: Missing or incorrect reset bearer token.

404.description: Reset disabled or no reset token configured.

get.summary: Read private watched history; newest recorded first, 25 per page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive title/original-title search across all watched movies. total/watch_minutes remain all-history totals; matched_total counts search results.

get.description: Includes watch_minutes for all watched movies, not just this page. User Service reads its own watched IDs and obtains durations through Movie Service API. Zero when no watched movies; null if durations are missing or Movie Service is unavailable.

413.description: Request body too large (Flask HTML response).

post.description: Idempotent catalog reset receipt; clears watched/watchlist links and retires movie IDs. deleted_rows counts watched entries only. Maximum body 8 MiB.

get.summary: Live watched-history updates for the current user.
get.description: SSE stream backed by committed PostgreSQL notifications. ready requests initial/reconnect synchronization; watched-changed requests a history reload; signed-out ends an expired/revoked session. Keep-alive comments do not trigger reloads.

200.description: SSE events: ready, watched-changed, signed-out; keep-alive comments. Watchlist changes share watched-changed.

503.description: Database unavailable or stream capacity reached; reconnect later.

post.summary: Mark a movie as not watched for the signed-in user
post.description: Requires session cookie and X-G15-Request: 1. Idempotent; only removes the current user’s watched record. Emits history update after commit.

413.description: Request body too large (Flask HTML response).

username.description: Unique across all accounts, ignoring case. Registration trims and lowercases it.

display_name.description: Trimmed before validation; need not be unique.

genres.description: Values from current catalog filter choices.

languages.description: Values from current catalog filter choices.

actors.description: Free-text names; trim, deduplicate case-insensitively; reject control characters. No catalog membership requirement.

directors.description: Free-text names; trim, deduplicate case-insensitively; reject control characters. No catalog membership requirement.

year_from.description: Upper bound is current year + 5; from must not exceed to.

year_to.description: Upper bound is current year + 5; from must not exceed to.

SessionCookie.name: g15_session
SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly cookie set by login/registration. Seven-day expiry; Secure outside local HTTP startup. Browser sends it automatically through /api/user.

ResetToken.description: Separate AUTH_RESET_TOKEN. Requires AUTH_RESET_ENABLED=true. Not a normal user session.
